sections.title: Opening
sections.text: I'm applying for the Senior Full Stack Engineer role at Mintleaf. I build fast, well-tested web products in React, TypeScript and Node.js, and I'd like to bring that to your payments team.

sections.title: Evidence
sections.text: At Brightwater Logistics I rebuilt the shipment tracking dashboard, cutting page load from 4.2s to 1.1s, and designed an event-driven pricing service on AWS Lambda and SQS that handles 2M quotes a month.

sections.title: Fit
sections.text: Your ad asks for strong SQL, AWS in production and mentoring. I cut API p95 latency from 900ms to 220ms at Mosaic Learning with Redis and query indexes, and I've mentored three graduate engineers.

sections.title: Close
sections.text: I'd welcome the chance to talk about how I can help Mintleaf ship faster. Thank you for considering my application.
